name: ai
title: AI
description: Workers AI for Lunora — bring LLMs to your functions with `ctx.ai`, powered by @lunora/ai (Vercel AI SDK over Cloudflare Workers AI). Scaffolds a summarise action and a sentiment analysis action as examples.
docs: After installing, add the `AI` binding to your `wrangler.jsonc` (the registry item adds it for you). Then run `lunora codegen` to wire `ctx.ai` onto ActionCtx. The shipped `summarize` and `analyzeSentiment` actions surface in the generated `api` as `ai/summarize` and `ai/analyzeSentiment` — edit them or use them as templates for your own AI actions. The `@lunora/ai` package re-exports helpers from the Vercel AI SDK (`generateText`, `streamText`, `embed`, tool`, etc.), so you can build agentic flows directly.
